items.title: 8.10 Position of equilibrium and reaction conditions

blocks.text: The position of equilibrium refers to the relative amounts of products and reactants present in an equilibrium mixture.
If a system in equilibrium is disturbed.

items: If the concentration of products is increased relative to the reactants, we say that the position of equilibrium has shifted to the left.
If the concentration of products is decreased relative to the reactants, we say that the position of equilibrium has shifted to the right.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The two directions are swapped. If the concentration of products increases relative to the reactants, the position of equilibrium has shifted to the right (towards the products); if it decreases, the position has shifted to the left.
